scripts.name: 循迹倒车页面
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtParkingGenaralInfo 5 0 0 0 0 0

scripts.name: 无有效路径
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtMRAInfo 3 3 0 1

scripts.name: 车门打开
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtParkingGenaralInfo 5 0 E 0 0 0

scripts.name: 请系好安全带
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtParkingGenaralInfo 5 0 F 0 0 0

scripts.name: 事件恢复
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtParkingGenaralInfo 0 0 0 0 0 0

scripts.name: 无有效路径重置
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtMRAInfo 3 0 0 0

scripts.name: 车门打开重置
scripts.command: adb shell dumpsys activity service com.bitech.pilotparking/com.bitech.intelligent.service.IntelligentDriveService soa ADASstrtParkingGenaralInfo 5 0 0 0 0 0
